title: 1987 Topps Garbage Pail Kids Series 7 Blockhead Blake #277b
descriptionText: The Blockhead BLAKE 277b trading card is a collectible from the 1987 Topps Garbage Pail Kids Series 7. This non-sport trading card features the character Blake in a unique and humorous style typical of the Garbage Pail Kids franchise. The card includes a sticker and is part of the iconic Series 7 set released by Topps in 1987. Fans and collectors of trading card singles often seek out rare and quirky cards like this one to add to their collection.
